name: Recommandé
intent: Default balance of image quality, playability and emulation headroom.

reasoning: A 1080p-class source at 1.25x is approximately 2400x1350, already close to 2560x1440 output.
This raises image quality substantially without approaching the 4x pixel cost of a 2.0x profile.
FXAA is a low-cost general anti-aliasing pass at this scale.
